data.name: Arjesh
data.gender_notes: Arjesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Arjesh derives from the Sanskrit words 'arj' meaning 'thunderbolt' and 'ish' meaning 'lord'. This name was borne by Arjuna, a central character in the Indian epic Mahabharata, who was known for his bravery and was aided by the god Krishna. The name Arjesh carries the meaning “Brave conqueror” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arjesh usually hope their child will grow to embody brave conqueror and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage, strength, and divine guidance.
data.etymology: Arjesh belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Brave conqueror.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Arjesh total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
